mutator.name: libredwg_dxf_objects_uaf_llm01_mutator
mutator.strategy: 50% libFuzzer default; 50% a001: locate 2/OBJECTS, pick random code-0 record by Seed, replace its value line with Seed-derived unrecognized name; if OBJECTS absent insert complete section before 0/EOF.

biases.code_hint: find_section_anchor(OBJECTS); count code-0 records until ENDSEC/EOF; k=Seed%count; replace value line; else construct 0/SECTION,2/OBJECTS,0/<random>,0/ENDSEC before 0/EOF

limits: Only records with numeric group code 0 inside the first 2/OBJECTS section are considered for replacement; if OBJECTS exists but has no usable code-0 record, mutate_a001 returns the original input as a failure path.
Constructed OBJECTS section uses CRLF as specified by plan; replacement preserves the existing line ending bytes of the targeted value line.
Locations are found by DXF record scanning, not by hard-coded byte offsets; the plan's offset is not relied on.
